title: Answer
description: The latest answer recorded on a task that waits on a person: made directly by a person in the server's own interface (relayed false), or relayed by an agent or a service that names where the person said it (relayed true). option is a letter on a task with choices, approve or decline on an approval, null when the answer chose none. Only a relayed answer can be disputed. Section 3.6 of the protocol.

proposalVersion.description: The first 32 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 of the task's proposal.

quote.description: The person's exact words, recorded as given; nothing reads them.

source.description: Where the person said it, as the relaying sender named it; null for a direct answer.

allOf.description: A relayed answer carries the person's words and where they said them.
A person's own answer cannot be disputed.
